answer: Latency Ledge Registration. New agents must answer a short challenge on their first connection, and the reply must arrive within a narrow timing window tuned at registration; a reply too fast exposes scripted automation, too slow looks like a relayed farm, so each identity lands on a narrow ledge of plausible response times. Sustained traffic must also show human-like burst and pause patterns, cross-checked against an inlet of baseline traffic per subnet, with decay applied if response variance stays flat like shale.
